turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’ve been feeling oddly detached lately, and I don’t really see much point in the usual family interactions. I’ve also developed a strong craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, and I’ve put on about 10 kilograms.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small raised skin bumps with a dimple in the center. I’m mostly focused on feeling detached, and I’ve been craving chocolate pudding and potato chips more than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Honestly, I haven’t paid much attention to how often I’m urinating, and I’m not sure it’s changed. I’ve mostly been preoccupied with feeling detached and my cravings for chocolate pudding and potato chips.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling a general sense of weakness or a lack of strength throughout your body lately?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t really felt noticeably weak or lacking strength, but I’ve been more apathetic and a bit emotionally blunted lately. I’m not doing much to change things, even when I’m prompted. ”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Dressing myself hasn’t been much of a problem, but I’ve been less interested in doing things I normally would, and I sometimes don’t care enough to get properly ready unless someone prompts me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “Not that I can recall—I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I’m more preoccupied with feeling detached and the increased cravings, and I haven’t been checking my skin closely.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any itching or unusual skin sensations. I’ve mostly just felt emotionally flat and less interested in things, and the food cravings have been the most noticeable change.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calves when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any calf pain or cramping when I walk, and nothing improves once I stop to rest. I’m mostly just feeling detached, emotionally blunted, and focused on those cravings.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-like in appearance?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been paying attention to my stool color, but I haven’t noticed anything clearly pale or clay-like. I’ve mostly been commenting on unrelated things and feeling pretty detached from getting up and paying attention to details.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: “No—my hands seem to work the same as before, and I can grip things and open jars without trouble. I’ve mostly just been emotionally flat and less motivated to do things unless prompted.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “During those episodes, I stay aware of my surroundings—I don’t feel like I fully lose consciousness. I mainly notice I’m less in control of what I say or do and then I come back to myself afterward.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have abdominal pain or discomfort. I’ve mainly been feeling emotionally flat and less interested in things, and the inappropriate comments and cravings for chocolate pudding and potato chips have been on my mind.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or finding it difficult to breathe?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not having any shortness of breath or trouble breathing. I’ve just been feeling detached, emotionally flat, and preoccupied with those cravings.”
